stats.notes: There is no readable Common Data Set: Minot State's Common Data Set page now points to a login-only SharePoint folder, so the figures come from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 entering class). College Navigator's newer fall 2024 figures: 701 applicants, 65% admitted, 78% of admitted enrolled (the admit rate fell from 72% in fall 2023, so it is not an open-admission school for every applicant). IPEDS gives no international applicant/admit split and no GPA data. Undergraduate enrollment 2,499 and student-to-faculty ratio 11:1 are College Navigator fall 2024.
